panels.title: Transactions / s
panels.description: counted from every confirmed block; perf samples are the node's own 60 s windows (cross-check, and the only source in accounts mode)

panels.title: Slots / s by leader client
panels.description: produced vs skipped per producing client (clientId from getClusterNodes)

panels.title: Commitment gaps (slots)
panels.description: consensus lag: how far confirmation and finality trail the tip

panels.title: Block compute (per block)
panels.description: cost units are what the block limit counts; set chain_watch.block_cost_limit for the fill ratio

panels.title: Stake by version
panels.description: a majority change is a timeline event (majority_version) in chain-watch's run store

panels.title: Feature gates (on chain)
panels.description: every Feature-program account: Value #A = activation slot; pending ones (Value #B = 0) activate at the next epoch boundary. Full history with times: chain-watch GET /features

panels.title: Outcomes / s (client view)
panels.description: landed / failed (on chain) / simulation_failed / rejected / expired / ambiguous / client, from ChainClient in every service

panels.title: CU per transaction by program
panels.description: consumed on chain; a step change after a feature activation is a repricing

panels.title: CU limit used
panels.description: consumed / requested; low values waste block space and priority fees

panels.title: Memory available and TCP sockets
panels.description: ephemeral-port exhaustion (EADDRNOTAVAIL) ended the x2000 run; sockets scaled by ~30k ports

panels.title: Venue price deviation from oracle
panels.description: (venue price - oracle) / oracle in bps; arbitrageurs pull AMMs back inside their threshold

panels.title: Hedged at the oracle (USD / 5m)
panels.description: inventory laid off at the oracle price (CEX-hedge model): sell_base = maker was long base

panels.title: Swap outcomes / min
panels.description: landed, or why not: unaffordable / no_price / quote_failed / preflight_rejected / send_failed / landed_failed / expired / rpc_ambiguous / error

panels.title: Cost vs oracle (bps)
panels.description: value given up versus the oracle: spread + fees + impact paid by uninformed flow

panels.title: Arb trades / min
panels.description: cycles found (above the profit floor) vs executed; below_floor = the cycle closed before sending

panels.title: Arb realized PnL (USD / 5m)
panels.description: every token the cycle touched, valued at oracle prices; SOL fees are separate (lamports panel)

panels.title: Arb fees (lamports / 5m) and cycles in flight
panels.description: fees include reverted cycles (lost races still pay) and first-use ATA rent
